title: Article 93 — The Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the House of the People

content.overview: Article 93 requires the House of the People to choose two members of the House to be respectively Speaker and Deputy Speaker as soon as may be, and to fill vacancies in those offices as they arise.
content.glance: Lok Sabha chooses Speaker and Deputy Speaker from its members; vacancies filled by fresh choice.
content.study:
Article 93:
The House of the People shall, as soon as may be, choose two members of the House to be respectively Speaker and Deputy Speaker thereof and, so often as the office of Speaker or Deputy Speaker becomes vacant, the House shall choose another member to be Speaker or Deputy Speaker, as the case may be.

Related: Arts 94–97 (vacation, resignation, removal, performance of duties, salaries).

Examination: both officers are chosen from members of the House; contrast with Rajya Sabha where Chairman is the Vice-President (ex officio).

sections.heading: Key points
sections.body:
- Speaker and Deputy Speaker: chosen by Lok Sabha from its members.
- Vacancy in either office: House chooses another member.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How are the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha chosen?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 93, the House of the People chooses two of its members to be Speaker and Deputy Speaker. When either office becomes vacant, the House chooses another member to fill it.

examTips: Speaker/Deputy Speaker elected from LS members; contrast VP as RS Chairman.

keyTakeaways: LS elects Speaker and Deputy Speaker from its members.
